CustomField.description: Session-scoped creation guard for flow-based upserts (#256): the form components generate this client-side when a submission or row is first staged, so a retry, autosave, or double click within the same session resolves to ONE record via upsert instead of duplicates. Unique + External ID (unlike the legacy ExternalId__c, which was released non-unique and therefore can never satisfy Flow's upsert-by-external-id validation). Once a record has an Id, all DML goes by Id and this field is inert. Blank on records saved before this field existed; the form components backfill a fresh value on the next touch purely for data hygiene, never copying ExternalId__c (whose historical duplicates must not enter a unique field).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: System-generated key that prevents duplicate records when a form save is retried in the same session. Populated automatically by the form components; leave it alone.
CustomField.label: Unique Id
